subject: infra.capacity
name: Compute or high-performance computing capacity
what_would_settle_it: A capacity disclosure for the National Data Centre - rack count, megawatts, uptime tier or utilisation - or a separate compute facility specification.

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A national open-data portal, the published National Data Governance Policy text, or an access-to-information instrument.

subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Chinese digital investment in Eswatini
what_would_settle_it: Any Chinese financing, contract or memorandum covering Eswatini digital infrastructure.

subject: gov.protect
name: United States bilateral health agreement and its data-sharing agreement
what_would_settle_it: The memorandum of understanding and the related data-sharing agreement themselves, a signature date, or an Eswatini government statement naming the instrument. The text is withheld rather than unpublished, and is in litigation in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia
disposition: not probed on this run; no web access on the nightly pass

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A Conta or audited statement of government accounts, or ministry annual reports, giving year-end spending by project and activity for the digital lines; the ICT ministry's 2024/25 report to Parliament gives in-year recurrent spending only.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Royal Science and Technology Park's own revenue and cost recovery
what_would_settle_it: The Park's annual report or audited accounts, showing what its data-centre colocation and hosting services earn against the government subvention.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Budget lines for public-institution connectivity after Digital Eswatini
what_would_settle_it: Line-ministry budget lines carrying the internet servicing costs of schools and clinics that the government committed to in the Digital Eswatini appraisal.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: The adopted National Data Governance Policy text, or a government cloud or hosting policy, fixing where state data is held.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data, portability and exit terms of the Google Cloud memorandum
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the memorandum between the ICT ministry and Google Cloud EMEA, with any data-location, portability and exit clauses.
